blocks.zh: 無菌處理醫療保健產品 — 第一部分：一般要求
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing of Health Care Products — Part 1: General Requirements

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 13408-1 作為整個無菌處理系列標準之總綱，掌握無菌製程定義（Aseptic Process Definition）的核心架構
blocks.en: Understand ISO 13408-1 as the umbrella standard for the whole aseptic processing series, and master the core structure of the Aseptic Process Definition

blocks.zh: 掌握無菌處理區域（APA）三層分區設計：關鍵處理區、直接支援區、間接支援區，及其對應 ISO 14644 潔淨室等級
blocks.en: Master the three-tier design of the aseptic processing area (APA): critical processing zone, direct support zone and indirect support zone, and their corresponding ISO 14644 cleanroom classes

blocks.zh: 學習風險管理在無菌製程中的四步驟：識別、評估、監測、預防，並理解其與 EU GMP Annex 1 CCS 的對應
blocks.en: Learn the four steps of risk management in aseptic processes: identify, evaluate, monitor, prevent, and understand how they map to the EU GMP Annex 1 CCS

blocks.zh: 掌握製程模擬（Process Simulation/APS）的設計、執行、評估完整要求
blocks.en: Master the full requirements for designing, executing and evaluating process simulation (APS)

blocks.zh: 了解人員管理（培訓、更衣、健康管理）在無菌保證中的關鍵角色
blocks.en: Understand the critical role of personnel management (training, gowning, health monitoring) in sterility assurance

blocks.zh: Clause 1–3: Scope, Normative References, and Terms & Definitions Clause 1–3：適用範圍、規範性引用文件與術語定義
blocks.en: Clause 1–3: Scope, Normative References, and Terms & Definitions

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌處理 vs. 終端滅菌 Aseptic Processing vs. Terminal Sterilization
blocks.en: Core Concept: Aseptic Processing vs. Terminal Sterilization

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 (Terminal Sterilization)：產品在最終密封容器中進行滅菌（如高壓蒸汽、輻射）。SAL 可計算，風險最低。
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization: The product is sterilized in its final sealed container (e.g. steam, radiation). The SAL can be calculated and the risk is lowest.

blocks.zh: 無菌處理 (Aseptic Processing)：當產品無法承受終端滅菌時（熱不穩定生物製劑、蛋白質藥物），預先對各組件滅菌後，在嚴格控制的無菌環境中組合充填。
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing: When a product cannot withstand terminal sterilization (heat-labile biologics, protein drugs), the components are sterilized beforehand and then assembled and filled in a tightly controlled aseptic environment.

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 的黃金原則：終端滅菌永遠是第一選擇。選擇無菌處理必須有充分科學依據。
blocks.en: The golden rule of ISO 13408-1: terminal sterilization is always the first choice. Choosing aseptic processing must be supported by sound scientific justification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy：手術室備餐
blocks.en: Analogy: Preparing a Meal in an Operating Room

blocks.zh: 想像你必須在手術室裡準備一份無菌餐點。你無法用微波爐重新加熱（=無法終端滅菌），所以你需要：預先消毒所有食材和餐具（=組件滅菌）、在手術室般嚴格控制的環境中操作（=APA）、穿戴完整手術衣（=更衣程序）。這就是無菌處理的本質。
blocks.en: Imagine you have to prepare a sterile meal inside an operating room. You cannot reheat it in a microwave (= terminal sterilization is not possible), so you need to: disinfect all the ingredients and utensils beforehand (= component sterilization), work in an environment as tightly controlled as an operating room (= APA), and wear full surgical gowns (= gowning procedure). That is the essence of aseptic processing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ISO 13408 系列架構
blocks.en: Key Point: Structure of the ISO 13408 Series

blocks.zh: ISO 13408 共七部分，Part 1 是總綱，其餘各部分針對具體技術：
blocks.en: ISO 13408 has seven parts. Part 1 is the umbrella standard and the other parts address specific technologies:

blocks.zh: Part 2：無菌過濾（濾膜過濾）
blocks.en: Part 2: Sterilizing filtration (membrane filtration)

blocks.zh: Part 3：凍乾（Lyophilization）
blocks.en: Part 3: Lyophilization

blocks.zh: Part 4：就地清洗（CIP）
blocks.en: Part 4: Clean-in-place (CIP)

blocks.zh: Part 5：就地滅菌（SIP）
blocks.en: Part 5: Sterilization-in-place (SIP)

blocks.zh: Part 6：隔離器系統（Isolators）
blocks.en: Part 6: Isolator systems

blocks.zh: Part 7：小量製品替代製程
blocks.en: Part 7: Alternative processes for small-volume products

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：多數無菌製劑 CDMO 同時涉及 Parts 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — 這意味著你的驗證系統必須跨越整個系列的要求。
blocks.en: CDMO application: most sterile-product CDMOs deal with Parts 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 at the same time, which means your validation system has to cover the requirements of the whole series.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個含有蛋白質的生物製劑注射液為何通常必須選擇無菌處理而非終端滅菌？
blocks.en: Why must a protein-containing biologic injectable usually use aseptic processing rather than terminal sterilization?

blocks.zh: 「Worst case」在無菌充填製程模擬（APS/Media Fill）中具體指什麼條件？
blocks.en: What exactly does "worst case" mean in an aseptic filling process simulation (APS/media fill)?

blocks.zh: APA 的三個分區（Critical, Direct Support, Indirect Support）對應 EU GMP Annex 1 的哪些分級？
blocks.en: Which EU GMP Annex 1 grades correspond to the three APA zones (Critical, Direct Support, Indirect Support)?

blocks.zh: Clauses 4–5: Quality System Elements & Aseptic Process Definition Clauses 4–5：品質系統要素與無菌製程定義
blocks.en: Clauses 4–5: Quality System Elements & Aseptic Process Definition

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌製程定義（Aseptic Process Definition）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Aseptic Process Definition

blocks.zh: 無菌製程定義是整個 ISO 13408-1 的靈魂文件。它要求你把所有 Unit Operations（單元操作）從組件預處理、過濾、充填到最終密封，一一列出並說明每個步驟如何維持無菌保證。
blocks.en: The Aseptic Process Definition is the heart of ISO 13408-1. It requires you to list all unit operations, from component preparation, filtration and filling through to final sealing, and to explain how each step maintains sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 實務上，這相當於 EU GMP Annex 1 要求的 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS)——一份活的文件，記錄你的無菌製程如何從設計層面控制每個污染風險。
blocks.en: In practice, this is equivalent to the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) required by EU GMP Annex 1: a living document that records how your aseptic process controls every contamination risk by design.

blocks.zh: 重要提示：與 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的連結
blocks.en: Key Point: Link to EU GMP Annex 1 (2022)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 第 2022 版強制要求 CCS，而 ISO 13408-1 的「Aseptic Process Definition + Risk Management」正是建構 CCS 的框架基礎。
blocks.en: The 2022 revision of EU GMP Annex 1 makes a CCS mandatory, and the "Aseptic Process Definition + Risk Management" in ISO 13408-1 is the framework on which a CCS is built.

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 → 5.2 風險管理四步驟完全對應 Annex 1 的 CCS 要素：識別 → 評估 → 監測 → 預防。兩者相互強化，共同構成無菌保證的核心論據。
blocks.en: ISO 13408-1 → 5.2 the four steps of risk management map fully onto the CCS elements of Annex 1: identify → evaluate → monitor → prevent. The two reinforce each other and together form the core argument for sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程定義框架 APD Framework
blocks.en: APD Framework

An Aseptic Process Definition (APD) includes these elements:
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 1. Product and component specs      │
│    - API / excipients / packaging   │
│    - Sterilization method and       │
│      validation for each component  │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 2. Process flow (unit operations)   │
│    - Compounding → filtration →     │
│      filling → stoppering → sealing │
│    - Sterility risk assessment      │
│      for each step                  │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 3. Environmental control            │
│    - APA zone design (Cl.5/7/8)     │
│    - HVAC / differential pressure / │
│      air change rate                │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 4. Personnel control                │
│    - Gowning / training / monitoring│
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 5. Validation program               │
│    - APS (media fill)               │
│    - Simulation frequency and       │
│      acceptance criteria            │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 場景
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Scenario

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，當你接受新客戶的生物製劑充填業務時，第一份要建立的核心文件就是「無菌製程定義（APD）」。這份文件不只是法規要求，它也是你向客戶展示技術能力的關鍵交付物，以及後續所有驗證活動的基礎。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, when you take on a new customer's biologic filling project, the first core document to establish is the Aseptic Process Definition (APD). It is not only a regulatory requirement: it is also a key deliverable that demonstrates your technical capability to the customer, and the basis for all subsequent validation activities.

blocks.zh: FMEA 或 HACCP 方法論（5.2.3 所提）應作為你的 APD 風險評估工具，系統性識別每個 unit operation 的潛在污染路徑。
blocks.en: FMEA or HACCP methodology (mentioned in 5.2.3) should serve as the risk assessment tool for your APD, systematically identifying the potential contamination pathways of each unit operation.

blocks.zh: 請列舉一個典型無菌充填線上的 5 個 Unit Operations，並說明每個的主要污染風險。
blocks.en: List 5 unit operations on a typical aseptic filling line and describe the main contamination risk of each.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISO 13408-1 要求在開始無菌處理之前先書面說明「為何不能終端滅菌」？這對藥品法規審查有何意義？
blocks.en: Why does ISO 13408-1 require a written explanation of "why terminal sterilization is not possible" before aseptic processing begins? What does this mean for regulatory review of the medicinal product?

blocks.zh: Clause 6: Manufacturing Environment Clause 6：製造環境
blocks.en: Clause 6: Manufacturing Environment

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：同心圓防護層
blocks.en: Analogy: Concentric Layers of Protection

blocks.zh:
把 APA 想像成一個軍事基地的同心圓防線：
• 最內層（Class 5/Grade A）= 核心指揮中心，任何人進入都需最高安全許可
• 中間層（Class 7/Grade B）= 安全緩衝區，控制入口、提供後勤支援
• 外層（Class 8/Grade C-D）= 外圍防線，一般控制但仍有管制
每層都通過壓差（正壓）像「氣體屏障」一樣阻止外部污染侵入。
blocks.en:
Think of the APA as the concentric lines of defense of a military base:
• Innermost layer (Class 5/Grade A) = the core command center; anyone entering needs the highest security clearance
• Middle layer (Class 7/Grade B) = a security buffer zone that controls entry and provides logistical support
• Outer layer (Class 8/Grade C-D) = the outer perimeter, with general but still controlled access
Each layer uses differential pressure (positive pressure) as an "air barrier" to keep external contamination out.

blocks.zh: 關鍵合規重點：環境監測程序
blocks.en: Key Compliance Point: Environmental Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 對環境監測的強制要求：
blocks.en: Mandatory environmental monitoring requirements in ISO 13408-1:

blocks.zh: 頻率：Grade A（每批/每班）、Grade B（每班）、Grade C/D（定期）
blocks.en: Frequency: Grade A (every batch/every shift), Grade B (every shift), Grade C/D (periodic)

blocks.zh: 人員監控：手指印每日強制監測，這比許多企業現行做法更嚴格
blocks.en: Personnel monitoring: fingerprints (finger dabs) must be monitored daily, which is stricter than the current practice of many companies

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析：不只看個別數值超標，必須建立趨勢報告
blocks.en: Trend analysis: do not look only at individual excursions; a trend report must be established

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定：Grade A 的任何微生物均需鑑定至種屬
blocks.en: Microbial identification: any microorganism recovered in Grade A must be identified to genus/species level

blocks.zh: 與 FDA 無菌處理指引的差異：FDA 要求 Grade A 連續粒子監測（real-time），ISO 13408 的語言相對原則性，但實務上都指向相同的嚴格標準。
blocks.en: Difference from the FDA aseptic processing guidance: the FDA requires continuous (real-time) particle monitoring in Grade A. The language of ISO 13408 is more principle-based, but in practice both point to the same strict standard.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：HVAC 驗證
blocks.en: Practical Application: HVAC Validation

blocks.zh: Air visualization（煙霧測試/airflow visualization study）是 ISO 13408-1 的強制要求，但也是最常在審計中被查問的項目。重點不只是「有做」，而是：
blocks.en: Air visualization (smoke test / airflow visualization study) is a mandatory requirement of ISO 13408-1, but it is also the item most often questioned in audits. The point is not just "having done it", but:

blocks.zh: 必須在 最差條件（worst case）下進行，包括最高人員負荷、設備運作中、開門/介入操作時
blocks.en: It must be performed under worst-case conditions, including the highest personnel load, equipment in operation, and door openings/interventions

blocks.zh: 必須記錄影像，且影像中清晰顯示 Grade A 區域的氣流確實保護產品暴露點
blocks.en: It must be recorded on video, and the video must clearly show that the airflow in the Grade A area really protects the product exposure points

blocks.zh: 任何設備配置更換後必須重做
blocks.en: It must be repeated after any change in equipment configuration

blocks.zh: 為何 ISO 13408-1 規定直接支援區須為 Class 7（Grade B）？如果降至 Class 8 是否可行？需要什麼額外控制措施？
blocks.en: Why does ISO 13408-1 require the direct support zone to be Class 7 (Grade B)? Would Class 8 be acceptable? What additional controls would be needed?

blocks.zh: 當一個 Grade A 環境監測點發現單一菌落，ISO 13408-1 要求你做什麼？與超過 Action Level 的處理有何不同？
blocks.en: When a single colony is found at a Grade A environmental monitoring location, what does ISO 13408-1 require you to do? How does this differ from handling an action level excursion?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：APA 三層分區對照表
blocks.en: Core Concept: Comparison of the Three APA Zones

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）特殊情況：當使用隔離器時，其周圍環境可降至 Class 8（Grade C/D），因為物理屏障取代了傳統 Grade B 的環境控制。這正是隔離器的商業價值所在。
blocks.en: Special case of isolators: when an isolator is used, its surrounding environment can be reduced to Class 8 (Grade C/D), because the physical barrier replaces the environmental control of a traditional Grade B. This is exactly where the commercial value of isolators lies.

blocks.zh: Clauses 7–9: Equipment, Personnel, and Manufacture of the Product Clauses 7–9：設備、人員與產品製造
blocks.en: Clauses 7–9: Equipment, Personnel, and Manufacture of the Product

blocks.zh: 核心概念：IQ/OQ/PQ 資格確認體系
blocks.en: Core Concept: IQ/OQ/PQ Qualification System

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 明確要求無菌製程相關設備必須完成三階段資格確認：
blocks.en: ISO 13408-1 explicitly requires that equipment used in aseptic processing complete the three stages of qualification:

blocks.zh: IQ（安裝資格確認）：設備按規格安裝，文件完整，零件可追溯
blocks.en: IQ (Installation Qualification): the equipment is installed per specification, documentation is complete, and parts are traceable

blocks.zh: OQ（運行資格確認）：在最差條件下設備運行符合預定範圍（如壓差、溫度）
blocks.en: OQ (Operational Qualification): the equipment operates within the predetermined ranges (e.g. differential pressure, temperature) under worst-case conditions

blocks.zh: PQ（性能資格確認）：在實際產品條件下，設備持續產出符合規格的結果
blocks.en: PQ (Performance Qualification): under actual product conditions, the equipment consistently produces results that meet specifications

blocks.zh: 關鍵：任何設備更改都必須重新評估對資格確認的影響——這是很多企業未嚴格執行的地方。
blocks.en: Key: any equipment change must be reassessed for its impact on qualification. This is where many companies fail to comply strictly.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：人員資格確認（APAQ）
blocks.en: Key Point: Personnel Qualification (APAQ)

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 要求每位進入 APA 的人員維持有效的 APAQ（APA Qualification），包括：
blocks.en: ISO 13408-1 requires every person entering the APA to maintain a valid APAQ (APA Qualification), including:

blocks.zh: 更衣驗證（Gown Qualification）：連續多次成功通過微生物採樣
blocks.en: Gowning qualification: several consecutive successful microbiological samplings

blocks.zh: 無菌技術考核（理論+實操）
blocks.en: Aseptic technique assessment (theory + hands-on)

blocks.zh: 定期重新確認（通常每年）
blocks.en: Periodic requalification (usually annually)

blocks.zh: 首次進入 Grade A 前必須通過 APS 觀察
blocks.en: Before first entry into Grade A, the person must pass an APS observation

blocks.zh: 這是 EU GMP Annex 1 第 2022 版的強化要求之一，也是 FDA 483 觀察的常見項目。
blocks.en: This is one of the strengthened requirements in the 2022 revision of EU GMP Annex 1 and a common FDA 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 製程持續時間控制 Process Duration Control
blocks.en: Process Duration Control

blocks.zh:
最大製程持續時間 = 生物負荷控制研究結果

關鍵時間節點需驗證：
1. 配液後到過濾的最大保存時間
   → 基於生物負荷增長研究（通常 0-24h @ 室溫）

2. 過濾後到充填完成的最大時間
   → 基於整個充填系統的無菌維持驗證

3. 半加塞產品在 Grade A 的最大暴露時間
   → 直接影響 APS 設計的持續時間

4. CIP/SIP 後設備的最大無菌保存時間
   → 決定生產計劃的彈性範圍

每個時間限制均需科學依據，不能隨意設定。
blocks.en:
Maximum process duration = result of the bioburden control study

Key time points to be validated:
1. Maximum hold time from compounding to filtration
   → based on bioburden growth studies (typically 0-24 h at room temperature)

2. Maximum time from filtration to completion of filling
   → based on validation of sterility maintenance of the whole filling system

3. Maximum exposure time of partially stoppered product in Grade A
   → directly affects the duration of the APS design

4. Maximum sterile hold time of equipment after CIP/SIP
   → determines the flexibility of the production schedule

Every time limit needs a scientific basis and cannot be set arbitrarily.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：消毒劑輪替
blocks.en: Analogy: Disinfectant Rotation

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 第 9.4 條要求消毒劑必須「輪替使用不同作用機制」，同時包含殺孢子劑。這就像醫院的抗生素使用策略：長期使用同一種消毒劑會導致耐藥性微生物滋生（如洗必泰耐藥的革蘭氏陰性菌）。輪替使用確保不同類型的微生物都被針對，殺孢子劑（如過氧化氫蒸汽）則處理最難殺滅的孢子。
blocks.en: Clause 9.4 of ISO 13408-1 requires that disinfectants be "rotated, using different mechanisms of action" and include a sporicidal agent. This is like an antibiotic strategy in a hospital: long-term use of a single disinfectant breeds resistant organisms (e.g. chlorhexidine-resistant Gram-negative bacteria). Rotation ensures that different types of microorganisms are all targeted, and the sporicidal agent (e.g. vaporized hydrogen peroxide) deals with the hardest-to-kill spores.

blocks.zh: 一個更衣資格確認（Gown Qualification）的合格標準如何設定？連續幾次成功是合理的？
blocks.en: How should the acceptance criteria for gowning qualification be set? How many consecutive successes are reasonable?

blocks.zh: 如果充填機在 APS 執行中途發生故障需要工程師進入 Grade A 區進行維修，這屬於什麼類型的「intervention」？如何在 APS 中模擬最差條件？
blocks.en: If the filling machine breaks down midway through an APS and an engineer has to enter the Grade A area to repair it, what type of "intervention" is this? How would you simulate the worst case in the APS?

blocks.zh: Clause 10: Process Simulation (Aseptic Process Simulation / Media Fill) Clause 10：製程模擬（無菌製程模擬 / 培養基充填試驗）
blocks.en: Clause 10: Process Simulation (Aseptic Process Simulation / Media Fill)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：製程模擬（APS/Media Fill）的意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Purpose of Process Simulation (APS/Media Fill)

blocks.zh: 製程模擬 (Process Simulation / APS)，俗稱培地充填 (Media Fill)：用微生物培養基（如大豆酪蛋白消化培養基 SCDM）替代實際產品，在完整模擬生產條件下充填，再培育觀察培養基是否出現微生物生長。
blocks.en: Process simulation (APS), commonly called media fill: a microbial growth medium (e.g. soybean casein digest medium, SCDM) is used in place of the actual product and filled under fully simulated production conditions, and the filled units are then incubated and examined for microbial growth.

blocks.zh: 這是目前唯一可行的方式，用於評估整個無菌製程維持無菌的能力。它不能計算 SAL（不像終端滅菌），但它是「整合測試」——驗證環境、人員、設備、程序的整體效果。
blocks.en: This is currently the only feasible way to evaluate the ability of the entire aseptic process to maintain sterility. It cannot calculate an SAL (unlike terminal sterilization), but it is an "integrated test": it verifies the combined effect of the environment, personnel, equipment and procedures.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：消防演習
blocks.en: Analogy: Fire Drill

blocks.zh: 製程模擬就像消防演習：你不需要真的發生火災（=真正有微生物污染的批次），但通過演習（=培地充填）可以評估緊急應對能力（=無菌處理能力）。如果演習發現問題（=培地充填失敗），你必須找出根本原因並修正，然後重新確認，才能繼續真正的生產。
blocks.en: Process simulation is like a fire drill: you do not need a real fire (= a batch that is actually contaminated), but through the drill (= media fill) you can assess your emergency response capability (= aseptic processing capability). If the drill reveals problems (= media fill failure), you must find the root cause and correct it, then requalify, before you can continue real production.

blocks.zh: APS 設計要素與合格標準
blocks.en: APS Design Elements and Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh:
初始資格確認 (Initial PQ)：
  - 至少 3 次連續成功 run
  - 每 run ≥ 3,000 單位
  - 每 run 零污染（0 個陽性單位）

定期重新確認 (Periodic Requalification)：
  - 頻率：每班每年至少 2 次
  - 合格標準：每 run 零污染

失敗後的行動：
  - 任何陽性 → 立即停產
  - 開啟偏差調查
  - 決定相關批次的處置
  - 重複初始資格確認（≥3 run）

最差條件必須包含：
  ✓ 最長生產持續時間
  ✓ 最多人員干預（interventions）
  ✓ 最多操作人員
  ✓ 模擬所有計劃中的班別
  ✓ 代表性容器規格
blocks.en:
Initial qualification (Initial PQ):
  - At least 3 consecutive successful runs
  - Each run ≥ 3,000 units
  - Zero contamination in each run (0 positive units)

Periodic requalification:
  - Frequency: at least 2 times per year per shift
  - Acceptance criterion: zero contamination in each run

Actions after a failure:
  - Any positive → stop production immediately
  - Open a deviation investigation
  - Decide on the disposition of the affected batches
  - Repeat the initial qualification (≥3 runs)

Worst case must include:
  ✓ Longest production duration
  ✓ Maximum number of interventions
  ✓ Maximum number of operators
  ✓ Simulation of all planned shifts
  ✓ Representative container formats

blocks.zh: 重要提示：APS 失敗的監管後果
blocks.en: Key Point: Regulatory Consequences of an APS Failure

blocks.zh: APS 失敗（任何陽性單位）是無菌製造中最嚴重的事件之一：
blocks.en: An APS failure (any positive unit) is one of the most serious events in aseptic manufacturing:

blocks.zh: EU GMP：同一製程期間生產的所有批次必須置於調查中，可能需要召回
blocks.en: EU GMP: all batches produced during the same process period must be placed under investigation, and a recall may be required

blocks.zh: FDA：可能導致Warning Letter，需要CAPA計畫
blocks.en: FDA: may lead to a Warning Letter and require a CAPA plan

blocks.zh: CDMO 影響：可能影響所有客戶產品的交付時間，商業損失巨大
blocks.en: CDMO impact: may affect delivery timelines for all customers' products, with huge commercial losses

blocks.zh: 因此，APS 程式的設計必須充分模擬最差條件，同時確保人員充分理解無菌技術的重要性。
blocks.en: Therefore the APS program must be designed to fully simulate worst-case conditions, while ensuring that personnel fully understand the importance of aseptic technique.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：何時需要重做 Initial PQ？
blocks.en: Practical Application: When Must the Initial PQ Be Repeated?

blocks.zh: 以下情況 ISO 13408-1 明確要求重做初始資格確認：
blocks.en: ISO 13408-1 explicitly requires repeating the initial qualification in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 充填設備大幅改造（如添加新的介入點）
blocks.en: Major modification of filling equipment (e.g. adding a new intervention point)

blocks.zh: 潔淨室 HVAC 系統重大改變（如換風機）
blocks.en: Significant change to the cleanroom HVAC system (e.g. replacing a fan)

blocks.zh: 設施長時間停產後復工
blocks.en: Restart of the facility after a prolonged shutdown

blocks.zh: 大量新員工加入無菌操作團隊
blocks.en: A large number of new employees joining the aseptic operations team

blocks.zh: 定期 run 失敗後的重新確認
blocks.en: Requalification after a failure of a periodic run

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，當客戶的產品轉移至貴公司時，通常需要做初始 APS（3 run），即使產品在原廠已有 APS 記錄。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, when a customer's product is transferred to your site, an initial APS (3 runs) is usually required, even if the product already has APS records at the original site.

blocks.zh: 為何 ISO 13408-1 規定 APS 每次最少 3,000 單位？這個數字的統計學意義是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does ISO 13408-1 specify a minimum of 3,000 units per APS? What is the statistical significance of this number?

blocks.zh: 在 APS 執行中，一個操作員掉落了鑷子並進行了介入操作，這個事件應如何記錄與評估？
blocks.en: During an APS, an operator drops a pair of forceps and performs an intervention. How should this event be recorded and evaluated?

blocks.zh: 如果一個充填線同時操作兩個班（早班/晚班），每年需要做幾次 APS run 才符合 ISO 13408-1 的要求？
blocks.en: If a filling line operates two shifts (day/night), how many APS runs per year are needed to meet the ISO 13408-1 requirements?

blocks.zh: Clauses 11–Annexes: Sterility Testing and Supporting Information Clauses 11–Annexes：無菌試驗與輔助資訊
blocks.en: Clauses 11–Annexes: Sterility Testing and Supporting Information

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌測試的侷限性
blocks.en: Core Concept: Limitations of Sterility Testing

blocks.zh: 無菌測試（Sterility Test）是最終產品放行的必要條件，但 ISO 13408-1 清楚認識到它的根本局限：
blocks.en: The sterility test is a necessary condition for final product release, but ISO 13408-1 clearly recognizes its fundamental limitations:

blocks.zh: 無菌測試只能測試少量樣品（通常 0.1% 以下的批次量），統計上根本無法保證整批無菌
blocks.en: A sterility test can only test a small number of samples (usually below 0.1% of the batch size), so statistically it cannot assure the sterility of the whole batch

blocks.zh: 若批次中 0.1% 的單位受污染，無菌測試找到的機率僅約 10%
blocks.en: If 0.1% of the units in a batch are contaminated, the probability that the sterility test detects it is only about 10%

blocks.zh: 測試本身可能產生假陽性（實驗室污染）和假陰性（污染水平過低）
blocks.en: The test itself may produce false positives (laboratory contamination) and false negatives (contamination level too low)

blocks.zh: 結論：無菌保證必須建立在製程控制上（通過 APS、環境監測），而非依賴最終測試。這是無菌製造哲學的核心。
blocks.en: Conclusion: sterility assurance must be built on process control (through APS and environmental monitoring), not on end-product testing. This is the core of aseptic manufacturing philosophy.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：無菌測試假陽性調查
blocks.en: Key Point: Investigating False-Positive Sterility Tests

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 第 11.2 條要求對陽性結果進行調查，確定是真陽性還是假陽性（實驗室污染）。這是一個嚴格要求：
blocks.en: Clause 11.2 of ISO 13408-1 requires that positive results be investigated to determine whether they are true positives or false positives (laboratory contamination). This is a strict requirement:

blocks.zh: 必須有書面的假陽性調查程序
blocks.en: A written false-positive investigation procedure is required

blocks.zh: 任何假陽性宣稱必須有充分的科學依據（不能只是「找不到原因」就宣稱假陽性）
blocks.en: Any false-positive claim must have sound scientific justification (it cannot be claimed simply because "no cause could be found")

blocks.zh: EU GMP 和 FDA 對此有非常嚴格的立場：假陽性必須極難被接受，需要重複測試和微生物鑑定支持
blocks.en: EU GMP and the FDA take a very strict position: a false positive must be extremely hard to accept and needs the support of retesting and microbial identification

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：安全帶 vs. 氣囊
blocks.en: Analogy: Seat Belt vs. Airbag

blocks.zh: 無菌製程控制（APS、EM、更衣程序）就像安全帶和道路設計——主動預防事故。無菌測試就像安全氣囊——在事故已發生後才啟動保護。好的無菌製造者依賴的是第一道防線，而非依賴最後的測試網。
blocks.en: Aseptic process controls (APS, EM, gowning procedures) are like seat belts and road design: they actively prevent accidents. The sterility test is like an airbag: it only protects after the accident has already happened. A good aseptic manufacturer relies on the first line of defense, not on the last safety net of testing.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：ISO 13408-1 在 CDMO 審計中的應用
blocks.en: Practical Application: ISO 13408-1 in CDMO Audits

blocks.zh: 客戶審計（Customer Audit）或法規當局查廠時，ISO 13408-1 合規性評估的關鍵查詢點：
blocks.en: During a customer audit or a regulatory inspection, the key points examined when assessing ISO 13408-1 compliance are:

blocks.zh: 是否有書面的 APD（無菌製程定義）？是否定期審查？
blocks.en: Is there a written APD (Aseptic Process Definition)? Is it reviewed periodically?

blocks.zh: APS 程式是否充分模擬最差條件？最近 3 次 run 結果？
blocks.en: Does the APS program adequately simulate worst-case conditions? What were the results of the last 3 runs?

blocks.zh: APAQ 記錄是否完整？每位 Grade A/B 操作員的資格確認狀態？
blocks.en: Are the APAQ records complete? What is the qualification status of each Grade A/B operator?

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪替程式是否有記錄？是否包含殺孢子劑？
blocks.en: Is the disinfectant rotation program documented? Does it include a sporicidal agent?

blocks.zh: EM 趨勢分析是否定期進行？有無 alert/action level 超標的 CAPA？
blocks.en: Is EM trend analysis performed regularly? Is there a CAPA for any alert/action level excursions?

blocks.zh: 一批無菌注射劑（批量 50,000 支）進行無菌測試，根據藥典規定取樣 40 支。若批次中有 10 支（0.02%）受污染，無菌測試找到問題的機率大約是多少？這說明什麼？
blocks.en: A batch of sterile injectables (batch size 50,000 vials) undergoes sterility testing, and 40 vials are sampled as required by the pharmacopoeia. If 10 vials in the batch (0.02%) are contaminated, what is the approximate probability that the sterility test detects the problem? What does this show?

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 Annex C 列出了無菌製程的典型風險因素（人員、環境、設備、物料、程序）。請針對「人員」類別列舉 5 個具體風險，並說明對應的控制措施。
blocks.en: ISO 13408-1 Annex C lists typical risk factors of an aseptic process (personnel, environment, equipment, materials, procedures). For the "personnel" category, list 5 specific risks and describe the corresponding control measures.

blocks.zh: 本部分重點回顧 Part 1 Summary
blocks.en: Part 1 Summary

blocks.zh: 總綱地位：ISO 13408-1 是整個系列的基礎，建立了無菌製程定義（APD）框架，後續各部分（2-7）在此基礎上擴展具體技術
blocks.en: Umbrella status: ISO 13408-1 is the foundation of the whole series and establishes the Aseptic Process Definition (APD) framework; the subsequent parts (2-7) build on it to cover specific technologies

blocks.zh: APA 三層分區：Critical (ISO Class 5/Grade A) → Direct Support (Class 7/Grade B) → Indirect Support (Class 8/Grade C-D)，隔離器可改變周圍環境要求
blocks.en: Three APA zones: Critical (ISO Class 5/Grade A) → Direct Support (Class 7/Grade B) → Indirect Support (Class 8/Grade C-D); isolators can change the requirements for the surrounding environment

blocks.zh: 風險管理四步驟：識別 → 評估 → 監測 → 預防，與 EU GMP Annex 1 CCS 理念完全一致
blocks.en: Four steps of risk management: identify → evaluate → monitor → prevent, fully consistent with the EU GMP Annex 1 CCS concept

blocks.zh: 製程模擬（APS）：初始 3 次連續成功，定期每班每年至少 2 次，每次 ≥3,000 單位，零污染標準
blocks.en: Process simulation (APS): initially 3 consecutive successful runs, periodically at least 2 times per year per shift, each run ≥3,000 units, zero-contamination criterion

blocks.zh: 無菌保證核心：依賴製程控制而非最終無菌測試，測試僅是最後驗證，無法保證整批無菌
blocks.en: Core of sterility assurance: rely on process control rather than the final sterility test; the test is only a last verification and cannot assure the sterility of the whole batch

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵：每位進入 APA 人員需維持有效的 APAQ；設備變更需評估對資格確認的影響；APD 是技術轉移的核心交付物
blocks.en: CDMO essentials: every person entering the APA must maintain a valid APAQ; equipment changes must be assessed for their impact on qualification; the APD is a core deliverable in technology transfer
